# Budgeted third-instructor review

Each essay has two available human scores and four previously released AI scores per trait. For each of three instructor rotations, hide the target instructor's four scores until evaluation. The case value is the mean absolute difference of those four scores from the midpoint of the two visible instructors. This is a measure of a discrepancy available for discovery. No archived adjudication, true grade, or review duration is available.

Split 38 writers into two equal folds by sorted SHA-256 of their published IDs, using a fixed prefix "p11-triage-1:". Fit a separate ordinary ridge regressor per target instructor on both tasks of the other 19 writers. Score 38 essays in each fold and instructor combination; choose seven (the floor of 20% capacity) with source-independent SHA-256 tie resolution. Each method selects 42 essay-rotations in total. The units include repeated essays scored using different pairs of visible instructors. Never use a target instructor's scores from any writer in the ranking pool for training. These are reused development writers.

The hypothesis is that consistent directional disagreement across traits identifies essays where independent scoring systems assign systematically different levels. The matched ridge uses task indicator, four absolute peer gaps, four absolute AI-to-human-midpoint differences, four AI score standard deviations and four human midpoint levels. Add three features calculated across traits: absolute mean signed AI-minus-human difference, fraction of traits where AI lies outside the peer interval, and absolute mean signed difference between visible instructors in fixed instructor order. All regressors use training-only z-scaling and fixed ridge penalty 10. Controls also include pure peer gap, pure AI-to-midpoint gap, AI spread, equal-weight sum of both gap scores and random selection (analytical expectation). The full-information oracle gives the attainable upper bound. The primary statistic is mean discovered discrepancy per reviewed essay; also report share of total discrepancy captured. Require an advantage of .05 score points per reviewed essay over each control in aggregate and positive differences in both writer folds. Keep all results. A pass would require fresh confirmation, including time and scoring reliability evidence to substantiate the original P11 endpoint.
